NAIDOC: 50 years of deadly

This year, national NAIDOC Week marks a powerful milestone: 50 years of deadly. Join us at an event from 6 to 13 July as we honour the histories, cultures and achievements of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

Explore our NAIDOC events

Researchers offer sweet alternative with ‘healthy’ low-calorie sugars

Dr Axayacatl Gonzalez and his team at UQ's Biosustainability Hub are harnessing natural processes to produce a variety of rare sugars with fewer calories than table sugar.
